hubs.label: Tufts cellular-agriculture education and research node
hubs.capability: Cultivated-meat research linked to cellular-agriculture coursework, certificate/minor reporting, outreach, and workforce-development activities.
hubs.evidenceType: protein-specific government grant record and recipient progress reporting
hubs.limitation: Verifies reported programme activities, not the size of the Boston alternative-protein labor market.

hubs.label: UC Davis cultivated-meat research/training candidate node
hubs.capability: Cultivated-meat research and training ecosystem referenced as federally and state supported in USDA NIFA project reporting.
hubs.evidenceType: government grant report referencing a protein-specific university consortium
hubs.limitation: Secondary reference in another project's report; suitable as candidate-site evidence, not as a quantified hub claim.

hubs.label: North Carolina life-sciences manufacturing workforce platform
hubs.capability: General biomanufacturing and life-sciences workforce pipeline, including community-college expansion and inclusive training infrastructure.
hubs.evidenceType: general biomanufacturing workforce programme plus U.S. alternative-protein stakeholder study
hubs.limitation: Adjacent capability only; the EDA source does not establish a protein-specific public programme or employment count.

hubs.label: Dutch cellular-agriculture national capability ecosystem
hubs.capability: National cellular-agriculture programme linking education, research, and scale-up facilities for cultivated meat and precision fermentation.
hubs.limitation: National ecosystem evidence; coordinate is approximate and should not imply Wageningen alone owns the capability.

hubs.label: UK Alternative Proteins IKC / NAPIC capability system
hubs.capability: Protein-specific centre model for research, commercialization, skills, technical staff, placements, and facility access.
hubs.evidenceType: official research-funding call, roadmap, and launch announcement
hubs.limitation: Programme design and launch evidence; does not prove employment impact or rank UK cities.

hubs.label: Denmark plant-based value-chain policy node
hubs.capability: Plant-based value-chain policy connecting crops, ingredients, education, public-private research, exports, and market development.
hubs.limitation: Plant-based policy evidence; not a full alternative-protein or cellular-agriculture capability claim.

hubs.label: Singapore Food Story and future-foods R&D capability
hubs.capability: Food-security R&D, alternative-protein process development, nutrition/functionality, food safety, commercialization, and international precision-fermentation collaboration.
hubs.evidenceType: official government parliamentary reply and policy speech
hubs.limitation: Official sources also identify cost and consumer-acceptance headwinds; capability does not imply solved adoption.

hubs.label: India DBT-BIRAC BioE3 smart-protein policy node
hubs.capability: Smart-protein policy covering plant-based, fermentation-derived, and cell-culture platforms, with proof-of-concept and pilot/pre-commercial scale-up categories.
hubs.evidenceType: official government call and parliamentary policy release
hubs.limitation: Policy architecture and calls are verified; project outcomes, workforce retention, and site-level capacity require follow-up.

hubs.label: South Africa agricultural STI roadmap capability node
hubs.capability: Inclusive agricultural STI roadmap covering institutional coordination, skills development, value chains, women and youth, and agricultural bioeconomy goals.
hubs.evidenceType: official government-FAO roadmap process plus academic emerging-food assessment
hubs.limitation: Broader agrifood innovation evidence; not a verified mature alternative-protein manufacturing hub.

hubs.label: Rio de Janeiro · Embrapa
hubs.limitation: 2022 technical guide; no workforce count or commercial-outcome estimate.

hubs.label: Brandon · food and engineering diplomas
hubs.capability: Food-science and engineering-technology education connected to food processing.
hubs.limitation: 2024 account; future graduate targets are not achieved outcomes.

hubs.label: Saskatoon · agrifood reskilling
hubs.capability: Agrifood conversion training and related workforce programmes.
hubs.limitation: Broader agrifood capacity; not solely alternative-protein employment.

hubs.label: Israel · cultivated-meat consortium
hubs.limitation: Approximate national locator; start2022, record2024; not a single campus or current staffing estimate.

hubs.label: Wuxi / Yixing · future-food engineering
hubs.capability: Future-food, biotechnology and food chemical-engineering research affiliations.
hubs.limitation: 2025 paper; includes adjacent food engineering; not an employment ranking.
